item.title: Slot Grind
item.description:
Title: Slot Grind
Genre: Casual , Indie
Developer: OneMoreSystem
Publisher: OneMoreSystem
Release Date: Aug 4, 2026




About This Game

Spin. Earn. Expand.

Pull the lever and watch your machines come alive. Every spin is a chance to earn, and the more machines you own, the faster your income grows! What starts with a single slot quickly turns into a table full of noise and money.

Upgrade Your Machines

Improve spin speed, increase rewards and push your setup further. Turn a simple machine into a money-printing engine.

Automate

Tired of clicking? Automate the slots and let your machines run on their own!

Progress through the Skill Tree!

Unlock new machines and powerful perks as you progress through the skill tree. Improve your setup, increase efficiency and push your earnings further with every upgrade. And who knows, maybe you'll finally be able to pay off all your debts?

AI Generated Content Disclosure

The developers describe how their game uses AI Generated Content like this:

No AI content is generated during gameplay. AI tools were used solely for code assistance during development, all code was reviewed and tested by the developer.

Every piece of art, music, sound, and text in the game was human-made.



System Requirements

Windows

MacOS

    Minimum:
    • OS: macOS 10.15 Catalina
    • Processor: Apple Silicon (M1) / Intel Core M
    • Memory: 1024 MB RAM
    • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel UHD 617)
    • Storage: 200 MB available space

item.title: Pih 2
item.description:
Title: Pih 2
Genre: Action , Indie
Developer: BecomeANobody
Publisher: BecomeANobody
Release Date: Aug 4, 2026




About This Game

The most anticipated game of the century is finally here!

Pih 2 is a one-hit-kill comedy FPS.

ONE HIT KILLS YOU. ONE HIT KILLS THE PIHS.

Learn every enemy, retry instantly, and turn each humiliating death into revenge.

THE GOAL: collect all the items in each level while the pihs try to end your life.

There's some angry hawgs coming for you. Ever heard of a 🐊 Pihgator? 🦈 Shark-Hawg? 🦝 Hogoon? What about a 🦅 Birdhawg?

There's some weird boats and hot air balloons you might need to use in some levels. Are they easy to drive? No. Will you crash them into things? Constantly.

The first "Pih" game gave people nightmares where all they hear is "YOU GOT HAMMED". Now it's time for Pih 2 to make you dream about being "BACONATED".

Are you ready ?

Descrierea conținutului pentru adulți indisponibilă.

System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • OS: Windows 10
    • Processor: intel core i5
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: Intel® Iris® Xe Graphics
    • Sound Card: any

item.title: Korea. IL-2 Series
item.description:
Title: Korea. IL-2 Series
Genre: Action , Simulation
Developer: 1C Game Studios
Publisher: FOR-GAMES CR LTD
Franchise: IL2 Series
Release Date: Aug 4, 2026




About This Game

Korea. IL-2 Series takes you to a pivotal moment in aviation history—a time when jet engines changed the skies forever. During the Korean War, the piston-engine aircraft of a bygone era clashed with the first jet fighters.

For the first time in the series, gamepads are supported in addition to joysticks and HOTAS control systems.

With a massive combat map, authentically recreated aircraft, and a well-crafted balance between simulation and accessibility, every dogfight is brought to life.

Become an ace, fight in legendary machines, or aim even higher and become a regiment’s commander. Lead squadrons, plot routes across the combat map, and issue orders to turn the tide of history. In the skies of Korea, you can be anyone: from a rank-and-file pilot to a strategist shaping the outcome of the campaign.

For the first time in the IL-2 series, full controller support has been implemented.

The aircraft of the Korean War have been recreated based on actual blueprints, historical photographs, flight manuals, and other archival materials. There are eight aircraft at your disposal.


(*Please note La‑11 and F‑84E Thunderjet are available in the Premium and Deluxe editions, or as a separate DLC).

Every instrument in the cockpit is fully functional and reflects the state of the aircraft’s systems in real time. You will be aiming and firing just as pilots did 75 years ago.

The game takes place on the largest map in the series' history, covering an area of over 200,000 square kilometers. The Korean Peninsula has been recreated based on historical maps and documents from the 1950s. All significant historical landscape changes have been accounted for, including reclaimed coastal areas and shoreline changes.

The map features dozens of airbases with historically accurate layouts, hundreds of settlements, and strategic objectives such as ports, dams, and transport hubs.

In Career mode, you will act as an air regiment commander, managing personnel and overseeing aviation logistics.

It is up to you to decide whether to take to the skies or focus on strategic tasks. As a regiment commander, you will maintain combat readiness, plan operations, and reinforce your units.

Korea features a highly detailed damage model for both aviation and ground objects. Aircraft, including strategic bombers, as well as ground vehicles, trains, and ships, receive damage corresponding to the nature of the hits sustained.

Every object reacts realistically to collisions, crashes, and combat damage, taking into account mass, speed, and the point of impact, directly affecting the behavior of the vehicle and the outcome of the battle.

In this new mode, you can examine each aircraft, ground vehicle, and naval vessel in detail. Explore the models, learn about their development and combat history, inspect aircraft cockpits, and compare technical specs, including detailed performance charts.

Your own personal museum, open anytime—a true treasure for anyone passionate about aviation and military history.

For the first time in the series, you can leave the cockpit and walk around the airfield where your regiment is based.

Animations of the people—pilots, soldiers, and civilians—were created using motion capture (MOCAP) technology, ensuring natural and lifelike movement.

Designed for full immersion:

  • Full VR support via OpenXR and OpenVR.

  • Accessibility: The game features detailed systems management, but there’s no need to memorize engine start-up sequences—you can take off and engage immediately.

  • Hardware support: From controllers to desktop joysticks and professional HOTAS systems.

AI Generated Content Disclosure

The developers describe how their game uses AI Generated Content like this:

Generative technologies are used in Korea. IL-2 Series as production tools for selected types of content: in-game radio communications, pilot portraits and images used in Career mode.

Radio communications use text-to-speech technology based on voice recordings made by our team and voice actors under the relevant agreements.

Pilot portraits and Career mode images are created with AI-assisted workflows based on our own assets, in-game screenshots, models, and historical references, then manually reviewed and refined by our artists.

Generative AI is not used as a replacement for creative direction. All such content is curated, checked, and finalized by the development team.



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10 / 11
    • Processor: 4-Core CPU 3.6+ GHz
    • Memory: 24 GB RAM
    • Graphics: 8 Gb Graphics Card no more than 2 generations old (RTX 3060 or RX 7600 level)
    • DirectX: Version 12
    • Storage: 35 GB available space
    • VR Support: OpenXR or Steam VR supported headsets. VR Controllers are not supported.
    • Additional Notes: Gamepad or Joystick are recommended
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10 / 11
    • Processor: 8-Core CPU 4.5 GHz
    • Memory: 32 GB RAM
    • Graphics: 12+ Gb Graphics Card (RTX 4080 or 7900 XTX level)
    • DirectX: Version 12
    • Storage: 35 GB available space
    • VR Support: OpenXR or Steam VR headsets (16+ Gb Current Gen Graphics Card recommended). VR Controllers are not supported.
    • Additional Notes: Joystick or HOTAS system are recommended

item.title: HellSlave II: Judgment of the Archon
item.description:
Title: HellSlave II: Judgment of the Archon
Genre: Adventure , Indie , RPG
Developer: Ars Goetia
Publisher: Dear Villagers
Franchise: HellSlave
Release Date: Aug 4, 2026




About This Game

Thousands of years of demonic warfare have torn the world to shreds. Six demon lords,
locked in an endless war, have brought ruin to all. Tired of this infernal chaos, the heavens have unleashed the Archon of Judgment, an unstoppable force set to destroy everything.

But before annihilation can begin, you’re given a final chance at salvation: destroy all the demons yourself or perish with the rest of the world and creation.


Welcome to HellSlave II: Judgment of the Archon, a dark fantasy dungeon crawler RPG where you're humanity's last twisted chance. As the spiritual successor to the critically acclaimed Hellslave, this sequel takes everything fans loved, gritty lore, comic book style hand-drawn art, and tactical combat that raises the bar to hell.

Customize Your Damnation

Start as a Warrior or Sorcerer and specialize in six deadly classes from spectral assassins to plague-bearing mages. Mix and match powers in a flexible talent tree and forge your path through fire and fury.

Turn-Based Combat with a Time Twist

Plan every move carefully with a unique time-based combat system. Each skill takes real-time seconds to execute, forcing you to balance aggression and survival in every brutal fight.

Explore a World on the Brink

Walk inside the map to travel an immersive overworld and explore cursed dungeons, ruined villages, and sanctuaries. Every location filled with lore, secrets, and characters clinging to the last threads of hope.

Fight or Be Forgotten

Face hordes of monstrous enemies and hellish bosses. Use active powers and passive talents to unleash devastating combos and ride the edge between light and complete corruption.

What’s New in HellSlave II?

• Randomized Loot System: Find, forge, and fine-tune gear with an overhauled crafting system

• Flexible Build Paths: All powers are accessible, but your class defines your journey.

• First-Person Combat View: Feel the impact. Get closer to the carnage.

• Time Management in Combat: Every second counts in this real-time/turn-based hybrid.

What Returns from the First Game?

• Dark, handcrafted universe and visuals that ooze style and sorrow.

• Deep character customization and class synergy.

• Strategic, turn-based battles with layered enemy design.

• A world soaked in lore, with haunting quests and rich storytelling/narration.

Made by Ars Goetia, Fueled by Fan Fire

The original HellSlave was a dark INDIE gem that lit the way. The passionate solo-dev returns with Judgment of the Archon, a sequel built on fan feedback, powered by ambition, and forged for those who crave a deeper, darker RPG experience.

For fans of grim fantasy, tactical turn-based combat, and narrative-rich dungeon crawlers, HellSlave II is your invitation to defy heaven, crush hell, and carve your legend in blood.

The demons aren’t your only enemy.

The clock is ticking. Judgment is coming.

Mature Content Description

The developers describe the content like this:

The game depicts violence scenes and discriminatory languages/ behaviour between fantasy races.



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • OS: Windows 10+
    • Processor: 2.8 Ghz Dual Core CPU
    • Memory: 4 GB RAM
    • Graphics: AMD Radeon HD 6670, GeForce GTX 200 series with at least 1GB
    Recommended:
    • OS: Windows 10+
    • Processor: Quad Core CPU
    • Memory: 4 GB RAM
    • Graphics: AMD R7 200 series, GeForce GTX 500 series

item.title: Big Walk
item.description:
Title: Big Walk
Genre: Adventure
Developer: House House
Publisher: Panic
Franchise: Panic
Release Date: Aug 4, 2026




About This Game

Big Walk is a cooperative multiplayer adventure about teamwork and talking.

Set out with your friends through a wide-open world full of challenges, puzzles, and discoveries. You’ll need to work together to find your way around, stay in contact using an assortment of tools and toys, and figure out new ways to communicate when you suddenly find yourself speechless.

Adventuring aside, there’s plenty of time to just hang out. Sit and watch the sunset, or steal your friend’s binoculars and kick them into the ocean. Spending time with friends is the best part of a big walk.

Features:

  • Talking!

    Our proximity voice chat system makes voices fade across distances, echo down corridors, muffle through walls, and crackle through walkie-talkies

  • Walking!

    Find your way around an open world together, at your own pace

  • Arms!!

    Point, wave, and gesture (or just flail around wildly) to communicate in situations where talking isn’t an option

  • Tools and Toys

    Walkie-talkies, laser pointers, binoculars, megaphones, flares, whiteboards (?), cowbells (??), a big golden head (???) and more

  • Flexible Player Count

    Big Walk can be played with as few as 2 players (i.e. a focused co-op experience) or as many as 12 (i.e. an absolute mess)

  • Crossplay

    Play online with your friends on other platforms

  • An Ending

    Big Walk is a hand-crafted cooperative adventure meant to be played start-to-finish with a group of friends
